Gap Description: No documentation covering automated CI/CD pipeline integrations (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins) to trigger zipBoard reviews on code changes.
Absence of WCAG compliance checklists or accessibility review workflows for ensuring reviewed content meets accessibility standards.
Limited troubleshooting steps for ad‑blocker or browser extension conflicts that prevent zipBoard extensions from loading or functioning.
Insufficient details on configuring SSO (SAML, OAuth) and IP whitelisting for enterprise accounts, including required metadata and test procedures.
Lack of comprehensive examples and reference implementations for webhook payload handling, rate limiting, and programmatic API usage to automate feedback loops.
